body: Over Thanksgiving, we McLarens will be in Mexico celebrating the wedding of my son Brett to his beautiful bride, Breana. (We’ve got a “B” thing going here.) It will be a small family wedding. So I’ll be avoiding technology for a week or so, and I don’t expect to post on the blog. Have a great Thanksgiving! I hope you’ll make time for a quiet walk, to savor how blessed you are and express your gratitude to our Creator … and I hope you’ll have some great hours feasting with family and friends, enjoying “the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living.”
